subject: general
question: Who among the following personalities is a Sarod Maestro?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Amjad Ali Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan**:

 
 
• He is a traditional Indian **sarod player** best recognized for his **quick and fluid ekhara taans**.
 
• Khan has been performing all around the world since the 1960s and was raised in a classical music family.
 
• He received the** Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian medal, in **2001**; the **Padma Bhushan**, India's third-highest civilian honor, in **1991**; and the **Padma Shree **in **1975**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad **Bismillah Khan was an Indian musician credited with popularizing the shehnai, a reeded woodwind instrument.
 
• Ustad Zakir Hussain is a globally renowned Tabla player.
 
• Hariprasad Chaurasia is a celebrated Bansuri player.
